prompt: Pixel art animation sprite sheet for a retro 2D action RPG, the exact same character as in the reference image (the Libertador: tousled dark brown hair, brown eyes, navy blue military coat with gold epaulettes and gold trim, white diagonal cross-belt, brown belt, a flowing blue cape lined with red and gold fleur-de-lis trim, white trousers, black boots with gold trim). His musket is slung on his back and he draws a straight steel cavalry sabre. Four frames in one row, equal cells on a flat chroma green #00FF00 background, same size and same baseline, front view facing the camera, crisp pixel art with 1px dark outline like the reference. The sabre must never be held vertically high above the head: keep it diagonal or horizontal near the body so no frame is much taller than the standing pose. Frames left to right: 1) charging: standing firm, sabre drawn and held low at the hip with both hands, head slightly bowed, cape stirring; 2) raising the sabre diagonally up across the chest with one arm, other fist clenched, determined glare; 3) the peak: sabre held diagonally out to the side at head height pointing up and outward, chest out, mouth open in a battle cry, cape billowing wide; 4) release: lunging forward with the sabre swept down and pointing forward at the viewer-side target, cape flaring behind. Big dramatic readable poses, no text, no letters, no effects outside the character.
